title: Glitch in the Timeline
blurb: Pokémon, Pluto, phones and brand-new discoveries, all scrambled up with older stuff.

cards.say: [Pokémon Go came out in 2016, twenty years after the first Pokémon game], [Tetris came packed in the box with the Game Boy everywhere but Japan], [a Pikachu balloon first floated in the Macy's Thanksgiving parade in 2001], and [Mario was already a plumber in his very first game, back in 1981].
cards.real: In his first game, Donkey Kong in 1981, Mario was a carpenter called Jumpman. He became a plumber in Mario Bros. two years later.

cards.say: [The first video ever posted on YouTube, in 2005, was filmed at a zoo], [the Nintendo Switch 2 came out in 2025, four years after the first Switch], [in 2016, experts moved giant pandas from endangered to vulnerable], and [the first text message ever sent, in 1992, said Merry Christmas].
cards.real: The first Switch came out in March 2017, so the Switch 2, released on June 5, 2025, arrived more than eight years later.

cards.say: [Scientists officially renamed Pluto a dwarf planet in 2016], [NASA's Opportunity rover was built to last 90 days on Mars and kept going almost 15 years], [in 2011, Neptune finished its first lap around the Sun since it was discovered], and [in 2022, NASA crashed a spacecraft into an asteroid on purpose to nudge it].
cards.real: Pluto was renamed a dwarf planet in August 2006, ten years earlier.

cards.say: [The first cell phone call ever was made to a worker at a rival company], [the first cell phone weighed about two and a half pounds], [when cell phones first went on sale, they cost about 400 dollars], and [in 2020, NASA sent a brand-new toilet up to the space station].
cards.real: When cell phones first went on sale in 1983, they cost about 3,500 to 4,000 dollars.

cards.say: [Minecraft's creepers began as a mistake when the game's maker tried to make a pig], [in 2016, the Chicago Cubs won their first World Series since 1908], [Nintendo stopped making playing cards back in the 1970s], and [in 2025, scientists announced the oldest ant fossil ever found].
cards.real: Nintendo kept making playing cards. In 2007 it even sold hanafuda cards with Mario on them.

cards.say: [In 2007, the Great Pyramid was voted one of the New Seven Wonders of the World], [the first coin-operated arcade video games showed up in 1971], [Nintendo sold a toy grabber arm called the Ultra Hand back in 1966], and [in 2016, scientists showed off a dinosaur tail, feathers and all, trapped in amber].
cards.real: The Great Pyramid wasn't one of the seven winners in 2007. It was given an honorary spot instead.

cards.say: [New Horizons flew for about nine and a half years to reach Pluto in 2015], [in 2016, an art museum in New York added 176 emoji from 1999 to its collection], [Pikachu's name mixes a sparkly sound with a mouse's squeak], and [tiny water bears called tardigrades rode a spacecraft to the Moon in 2007].
cards.real: In 2007 the tardigrades rode the FOTON-M3 spacecraft in a low orbit around Earth, nowhere near the Moon.

cards.say: [Barbie's official birthday is March 9, 1959], [two Barbie dolls blasted off to visit the Moon in 2022], [the first cell phone could only talk for about 35 minutes on one charge], and [in 2021, tree rings proved Vikings were in Canada in the year 1021].
cards.real: In 2022 the two Barbie dolls toured the International Space Station, which circles Earth, not the Moon.

cards.say: [Pikachu, created in 1996, was designed by the same man who created Mario], [Pong came out the same year as the first home video game console], [in 2012, a man jumped from a balloon 24 miles up and fell faster than sound], and [Toy Story, from 1995, was the first full-length movie made all on computers].
cards.real: Pikachu was drawn by Atsuko Nishida, and Ken Sugimori finished the design. Mario was created by Shigeru Miyamoto.

cards.say: [In 2008, Michael Phelps won eight gold medals at a single Olympics], [Shrek won the very first Oscar for Best Animated Feature], [the first Harry Potter book came out in 1997, in Britain], and [the first iPhone came out in 2010, the same year as the first iPad].
cards.real: The first iPhone came out in 2007, three years before the first iPad in 2010.

cards.say: [In 2009, Usain Bolt ran 100 meters in 9.58 seconds, a world record], [basketball's handwritten first rules sold for about 43,000 dollars in 2010], [people at MIT made a space video game called Spacewar in 1962], and [Wikipedia, the free online encyclopedia, first went online in 2001].
cards.real: James Naismith's original basketball rules sold at an auction in 2010 for 4.3 million dollars.

cards.say: [In 1999, two men made the first nonstop balloon trip around the world], [a man flew a balloon around the world in about 11 days in 2016], [Steve Fossett flew a balloon solo around the world in 2002, on his first try], and [a Japanese airline painted Pikachu on its jumbo jets in 1998].
cards.real: Fossett did fly around the world alone in 2002, but only on his sixth try.
